necessity_paragraph: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and a sensation of rapid heart rate, raising clinical suspicion for supraventricular tachycardia. To accurately capture the arrhythmia during symptomatic events and guide further management, a mobile cardiac telemetry study is ordered for continuous rhythm monitoring. This service corresponds to CPT 93229 and is supported by diagnosis codes I47.1 and R00.2.
